messages:
maria: heads up — GHAS -> scanner webhook started sending duplicate run events at ~03:12 UTC. Trivy workers then hit a bunch of KMS decrypt errors and a few scans failed mid-run.
jordan: I rolled a small RBAC tighten this morning (removed a broad session tag permission). Could be related. When did the errors start?
maria: first fail spikes at 03:08, duplicates around 03:12. sample from scanner logs:
```
2026-03-20T03:09:12Z ERROR scanner-runner kms.Decrypt AccessDeniedException arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abc123 principal=arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/scanner-runner/session-xyz op=Decrypt
```
lee: also saw GHAS webhook payload shape change — webhook now includes workspaceId field and we use run_id+sha as dedupe key. If payload changed the dedupe key may no longer match and we processed duplicates.
ops-bot: deploy 1719001200 by @jordan succeeded: scanners/api v2.1.4
jordan: confirmed deploy at 03:02. I removed sts:TagSession and tightened trust policy for the scanner role. I didn't expect KMS decrypt to require TagSession but maybe our key policy references session tags. rolling a rollback now.
maria: another bad side-effect — suppression mapping dropped a handful of alerts because the duplicate runs had slightly different metadata. we accidentally suppressed a true high severity alert: CVE-2025-0001 appeared, then suppression rule matched due to missing run_id field.
alex: that CVE is P1 for affected services. If those results were suppressed we need immediate patch prioritization and owner notifications.
lee: proposing a remediation plan:
1) jordan — rollback the RBAC change (done asap)
2) lee — re-run scans for affected repos with dedupe disabled: `./scan-retry --repo-file affected.txt --since 2026-03-20T02:00Z`
3) alex/maria — backfill alerts and re-evaluate suppression rules for metadata variance
4) add an alert for KMS Decrypt AccessDenied spikes and a runbook entry

maria: sample affected repo list (first 6):
- infra/config-service
- api/session-proxy
- web/frontend
- data/ingest-worker
- billing/chargeflow
- onboarding/connector

jordan: rollback in progress, switching trust policy back to previous version and re-deploying role. ETA ~8m.
lee: starting backfill now with dedupe disabled. kicking off jobs in batches of 20. posting job ids as they start. ETA ~50m for first wave.
ops-bot: scanner-backfill-job 9876 started by lee at 2026-03-20T04:15:00Z
deploy-bot: role-update 1719001500 by @jordan rolled back to scanners-role v2026-03-19 (sha: d4c3b2)
lee: quick note — dedupe logic change we need: fallback on webhook event ID or commit timestamp when run_id differs. filing PR to scanners repo now.
alex: P1 action: add CVE-2025-0001 and CVE-2025-0042 to emergency patch queue, notify PO teams, and schedule hotfix cadence. I'll open the ticket and tag owners.
maria: I'll draft the incident summary and the playbook addendum for KMS decrypt alerts. Also we'll add a small GHAS regression test to ensure webhook payload changes don't break dedupe.
lee: update — first backfill batch finished, found 3 previously-suppressed high-severity alerts; re-notifying owners. continuing with batch 2.
jordan: thanks all. after rollback I'll add an integration test that exercises KMS decrypt with current key policy to catch this during deploys.
alex: agreed. also add a check to suppression rules UI to show which metadata keys are required for a match so we don't accidentally hide real findings.
maria: created ticket SEC-4572 with the action items and owners. tagging this thread reference in the ticket. will follow up with postmortem once backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
